provenance.base_provenance: Pass 29 frozen PBC V3.1 Quality streams; decoded arrays from Pass 31
provenance.dct: SciPy type-II orthonormal DCT/IDCT, float64, axes spatial (0,1), workers=1

config.sparse: 8x8 RGB DCT, 16 energy/estimated-byte shortlist, exact single-coefficient clipped SSE ranking, at most 8 coefficients per block

progression_gate.criterion: at least two initial content cases with >=10% lower RGB MSE within 5% rate or >=10% fewer bytes within 5% MSE, at measured points

timing_summary.encoder_timing_definition: DCT/block analysis family time amortized equally over three lambda outputs, plus median repeated complete stream serialization; not isolated single-point encode timing

analysis.mode_and_parameter_accounting: all modes and payloads included; sparse position/value/count/mask bytes separately recorded
